data.narrative:
Biobot Analytics is a Series B biotech company that has raised $40M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 8 private and 3 public companies in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $40M raised proxy, implying $76M. Peer-median anchoring across the 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range of $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied; the sector median P/S is 6.6x across 3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L), but Biobot's revenue is not on file.

The triangulation of applicable methods supports a valuation range of $65M to $4.0B, with a median of $1.8B. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty: stage-progression yields a conservative floor, while peer medians—dominated by later-stage Series C outliers—pull substantially higher. Key unknowns include Biobot's revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and competitive positioning within wastewater epidemiology. Without near-term revenue disclosure or narrower peer comparables at identical stage, the median estimate carries low confidence.
